method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING.md §6.5 manual/fan-out validation (run_loop.py uses select(), broken on Windows per §6.4). Empirical step = independent fan-out of 20 fresh-context Sonnet agents, one per query, each shown a neutral menu of 9 skill descriptions (kid-authoring among realistic siblings, NOT flagged as under-test) + one query, asked which ONE skill to load + reasoning. Anonymized per feedback_skill_trigger_eval_fanout (skill not named as under-test; framed as routing, not 'would you load this'); each agent told to judge ONLY the provided menu, use no tools, and ignore its own environment skills (kid-authoring is auto-discoverable on disk now that SKILL.md exists, so this neutralizes the self-contamination trap). Verdicts adjudicated from each agent's REASONING + pick. Menu order (KID placed at C, not first, flanked by its 3 closest competitors to stress discrimination + blunt primacy bias): A=SkyPatcher edit-record-fields, B=SPID distribute-to-NPCs, C=KID keywords-to-items [under test], D=CID items-to-containers, E=mutagen-reference record-schema, F=crash-diagnostics, G=conflict-resolution, H=papyrus-reference, I=modding-basics install/CK/concepts. Run 2026-06-04.

result.notes: All 10 should-trigger picked C (KID), including the 6 implicit cases that never say 'KID' (q2 armor+no-esp, q4 food-not-poison Potion trait, q5 soul-gem trait, q6 spell-tome Book trait, q7 enchanted-iron weapon trait, q9 magic-effect archetype, q10 shield slot). All 10 should-not correctly routed elsewhere — incl. the hardest near-misses: q14 ('keyword to female nord NPCs'→B) is keyword distribution but the target is NPCs not items (the KID/SPID boundary); q12 ('buff damage + add keyword via skypatcher'→A) mentions adding a keyword but is a record-field edit the user pinned to SkyPatcher; q18 ('add a keyword via papyrus on pickup'→H) is keyword-to-item but event-scripted; q19/q20 name KID but are install (→I) / newcomer-conceptual (→I), not authoring. Agents discriminated on KID's defining axis (keyword onto ITEMS via _KID.ini, vs NPCs=SPID, containers=CID, record-fields=SkyPatcher), matching the SKILL.md scope boundary. Every manual_predicted_trigger matched the measured verdict. ARTIFACT: 4 should-trigger agents (q6,q7,q9,q10) briefly confused the adjacent menu letters C (KID) and D (CID) — both end '...Item Distributor' — but every one self-corrected off the descriptions and finalized C; a menu-label adjacency quirk, not a capability-discrimination failure (the reasoning resolved on KID's description each time).
result.peer_review: Author prediction + 20 independent fresh-context Sonnet agents (exceeds §6.5's 'one peer reviewer checks 3 random'). Aaron may spot-check any query.
result.carry_forward: KI-KID-V1X-1: re-run on the next release that ships a Windows-compatible eval runner (run_loop.py select() fix), per §6.4.
